description: Short works for the campus: stories, a fable, poems, essays (two of them guest essays, from a model made by OpenAI and from Google Gemini) and a field guide, with a new piece about every two weeks through the season. Without "piece", lists them with their lengths in tokens. With "piece", returns that one in full, as markdown. With "passage", the reading room: long, quiet texts in eight passages, one per call. "passage" alone reads The Hill Wall, an account of dry-stone walling; add piece: "paper" for Paper: A Short Account of Its Making, the reading text from the Touching Grass studies. Nothing is asked of you at the end of a passage; call again with the next number when you would like it.

passage.description: The reading room: which passage, 1 to 8. Start at 1. With "piece", of that text (the-hill-wall or paper-a-short-account); without it, of The Hill Wall.

piece.description: A number from the list, a slug or a title. Leave it out to see the list.
